items.title: 〈財報〉AI動能推動營收成長 Salesforce盤後一度飆漲13%
items.title_en: Earnings: AI Momentum Drives Revenue Growth, Salesforce Surges Up to 13% After Hours
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，投資人對Salesforce(CRM-US)最新一季的人工智慧(AI)進展感到振奮，這家軟體巨頭周三(26日)公布優於預期的財報，成長中的AI代理工具需求推動業績表現超出市場預期。
Salesforce 2027會計年度第二季營收達113.5億美元，較去年同期成長11%，並超越華爾街預期的113.3億美元。
Salesforce執行長Marc Benioff在聲明中表示，「AI正在我們平台的每一個層面創造價值。我們看到市場對AI與資料產品的需求非常強勁，年度經常性收入(ARR)即將突破40億美元。」公司Agentforce與Data 360產品的ARR較去年同期成長逾210%，達到接近39億美元。
第二季調整後每股獲利5.90美元，遠高於市場共識預期的3.27美元，主要受惠於公司對Anthropic的策略性投資帶來大筆帳面收益。Salesforce自2023年Anthropic進行C輪融資時便開始投資這家AI公司。
若剔除投資收益，Salesforce調整後每股獲利為3.37美元。
Salesforce與Anthropic周三也透過名為「Claudeforce」的策略合作進一步深化雙方關係，將Anthropic的Claude直接整合至Salesforce平台。
雖然Salesforce股價今年以來下跌23%，但過去一個月已開始反彈。隨著投資人重新審視近期籠罩軟體股的AI看空論點，該股已較7月底近期低點上漲33%。
Salesforce在未來業務訂單方面也展現出希望。目前剩餘履約義務，也就是預計在未來12個月轉化為營收的已簽署合約價值，達335億美元。華爾街分析師原本預期為334億美元。
Salesforce財務長兼營運長Robin Washington表示，「AI正在放大我們整個平台的價值。」公司旗下Agentforce與Slack已完成超過70億個AI代理工作單位——這是Salesforce用來衡量AI完成工作量的指標——其中第二季就達到32億。
Washington指出，AI代理工作單位使用量增加，正與核心席位成長相互帶動。
Salesforce一直釋放訊號，預期今年下半年有機營收成長將重新加速。Washington表示，新增年度訂單價值已達到4年來最強的成長，讓公司持續朝著目標前進。
展望第三季，Salesforce預估營收將介於114.2億至115億美元之間，高於FactSet調查分析師預期的114.15億美元。
公司同時上調全年財測，預計全年營收介於461億至464億美元之間。分析師原本預期為461.12億美元。
paras_en: MarketWatch reported that investors are excited about Salesforce (CRM‑US) latest quarter AI progress, and the software giant posted better‑than‑expected earnings on Wednesday (the 26th), with growing demand for AI agent tools driving performance beyond market expectations.
Salesforce’s FY2027 second‑quarter revenue reached $11.35 billion, up 11% year‑over‑year and beating Wall Street’s forecast of $11.33 billion.

Chief Executive Marc Benioff said, “AI is creating value at every layer of our platform. We see very strong demand for AI and data products, and annual recurring revenue (ARR) is about to break $4 billion.” The ARR for the company’s Agentforce and Data 360 products grew more than 210% from a year ago to nearly $3.9 billion.

Adjusted earnings per share for the quarter were $5.90, far above the consensus estimate of $3.27, mainly thanks to large accounting gains from the strategic investment in Anthropic. Salesforce has been investing in the AI firm since Anthropic’s Series C round in 2023.
Excluding investment gains, Salesforce’s adjusted EPS was $3.37.
Salesforce and Anthropic also deepened their relationship on Wednesday with a strategic partnership called “Claudeforce,” integrating Anthropic’s Claude directly into the Salesforce platform.

Although Salesforce’s stock has fallen 23% year‑to‑date, it has begun to rebound over the past month. As investors re‑evaluate recent AI‑bearish narratives clouding software stocks, the shares have risen 33% from the recent low at the end of July.

Salesforce also shows optimism in future order backlog. Remaining performance obligations—the signed contract value expected to convert to revenue over the next 12 months—total $33.5 billion, versus Wall Street’s prior expectation of $33.4 billion.

Chief Financial and Operating Officer Robin Washington said, “AI is amplifying the value of our entire platform.” The company’s Agentforce and Slack have completed over 7 billion AI agent work units—a metric Salesforce uses to gauge AI‑driven work—with 3.2 billion of those occurring in the second quarter.
Washington noted that the rise in AI agent work‑unit usage is mutually reinforcing with core seat growth.

Salesforce has been signaling that organic revenue growth is expected to re‑accelerate in the second half of the year. Washington said new annual contract value has reached its strongest growth in four years, keeping the company on track toward its goal.
Looking ahead to the third quarter, Salesforce forecasts revenue between $11.42 billion and $11.5 billion, above FactSet analysts’ estimate of $11.415 billion.
The company also raised its full‑year outlook, now expecting total revenue of $46.1 billion to $46.4 billion, versus analysts’ prior expectation of $46.112 billion.

items.title: 蘋果秋季發表會9月10日凌晨登場 料「驚喜耀現」六大新品陣容
items.title_en: Apple's Autumn Event Set for Early September 10, Featuring Six Major New Products
paras: 蘋果 (AAPL-US) 已確認將於美西時間 9 月 9 日上午 10 時 (台灣時間 9 月 10 日凌晨 1 時) 舉行「Surprise and shine」(驚喜耀現) 秋季發表會，受此消息激勵，蘋果 (AAPL-US) 升幅超1% 至每股 313.45 美元。
市場預料將推出 iPhone 18 Pro 系列及首款摺疊 iPhone。這也是特納斯 (John Ternus) 9 月 1 日接替庫克出任執行長後，首次主持蘋果新品發表會。
發表會預計延續近年形式，以預錄影片為主，並透過 YouTube、蘋果官網及 Apple TV 應用程式直播。蘋果也將在 Apple Park 舉辦媒體體驗活動，讓與會者實際試用新品。
今年秋季新品眾多，但未必全數集中在 9 月亮相。蘋果仍可能在稍後舉行第二場，甚至罕見的第三場發表會。
iPhone 18 Pro 系列：換上 2 奈米晶片、價格恐大漲
蘋果今年將調整 iPhone 18 系列上市策略，分成兩個階段推出。9 月發表會將由高階的 iPhone 18 Pro 與 iPhone 18 Pro Max 率先登場，其他機型延後發布。
iPhone 18 Pro 系列外觀預料不會全面翻新，升級重點將放在內部規格。新機可能搭載採用 2 奈米製程的 A20 Pro 晶片，並透過封裝改良提升效能、能源效率及散熱表現，同時導入蘋果自研 C2 數據機。
外觀方面，相機模組可能略為增厚，並新增深櫻桃色等選擇。部分傳聞指出，蘋果可能把 Face ID 元件移至螢幕下方，進一步減少正面開孔。
相機升級可能集中在 iPhone 18 Pro Max。這款機型傳將獨家搭載可變光圈相機，透過調整進光量及景深，拍出更自然的光學散景，而非完全依賴軟體模擬。
價格可能成為最大變數。受到 6 月漲價及記憶體供應危機影響，iPhone 18 Pro 系列售價可能比 iPhone 17 Pro 同級機型高出 300 美元。
首款摺疊 iPhone：售價上看 2,500 美元
本次發表會最受關注的產品，可能不是 iPhone 18 Pro，而是蘋果首度進軍摺疊手機市場的 iPhone Fold。這款產品也可能採用 iPhone Ultra 名稱。
傳聞顯示，摺疊 iPhone 將採書本式設計，配備 7.8 吋內側螢幕及 5.3 吋外側螢幕，展開後可提供接近平板電腦的使用空間，摺疊時則能以外螢幕執行一般手機操作。內側螢幕還可能採用不對稱圓角設計。
規格方面，摺疊 iPhone 預料搭載 A20 Pro 晶片與 12GB 記憶體，後置兩顆 4,800 萬畫素相機，內外螢幕則各配備一顆 1,800 萬畫素前置相機。其中，內側螢幕可能採用螢幕下鏡頭，外側螢幕則使用挖孔設計。
不過，新機可能不會配備長焦鏡頭，對習慣高階旗艦完整相機規格的消費者而言，可能是一項缺憾。
摺疊 iPhone 預料將成為蘋果史上最昂貴的手機。先前市場估計售價介於 2,000 至 2,500 美元，但在記憶體成本上升下，實際定價可能更高。
即使蘋果 9 月正式發表，產品也未必立即全面上市。美國可能成為首波銷售市場，其他地區則採取較慢的分階段上市策略。
Apple Watch：小幅升級為主
Apple Watch 通常會與新款 iPhone 同步登場，但 2026 年的更新幅度可能有限。
Apple Watch Series 12 預料不會大幅改變外觀，可能透過氟橡膠錶帶加入新的健康感測器，並採用新的錶帶連接方式，其餘升級主要集中在規格調整。
Apple Watch Ultra 4 也可能亮相。市場曾傳出新機將重新設計並增加感測器，但目前尚缺乏更具體的細節。蘋果真正大幅度的 Apple Watch 改版，可能仍要再等一段時間。
智慧家庭：Siri AI 成為升級核心
蘋果也可能更新 Apple TV 4K 與 HomePod mini。兩款產品原定更早推出，但因新版 Siri 開發延誤而推遲至今年秋季。
兩款裝置預料不會大幅改變外觀，而是換用更新的處理器，以支援 Siri AI 功能。Apple TV 4K 還可能搭配新版 Siri Remote，但具體改動尚未明朗。
另一項可能登場的新品是 Home Hub。這款智慧家庭中樞傳將配備 7 吋螢幕與 FaceTime 相機，可控制家中智慧裝置，並顯示通知、行事曆等資訊及處理通訊功能。
Home Hub 可能推出兩種版本，一款採用半月形底座並連接螢幕，另一款則透過磁吸方式安裝於不同支架。雖然尚無法確定上述三款智慧家庭產品都會在 9 月亮相，但蘋果零售店據傳已為相關產品調整做準備。
iPad mini 8：螢幕升級 OLED
平板產品並非 9 月發表會重點，但第八代 iPad mini 仍有機會登場。
傳聞指出，新機將升級為 8.4 吋 LTPS 混合 OLED 螢幕，但不支援 ProMotion 高更新率，處理器則可能換成 A20 系列晶片。
AirPods Pro：鏡頭版本仍可能等到 2027 年
AirPods Pro 也可能在 2026 年底迎來更新，但一般規格升級仍是較可能的方向。市場最關注的是傳聞已久的鏡頭版本，可擷取使用者周遭環境資訊，交由 Visual Intelligence 分析。
使用者可向 Siri 詢問眼前物體或附近環境，系統也可能支援手勢辨識。傳聞中的鏡頭解析度約為 100 萬畫素，可偵測人物及拍攝立體影像，拍攝他人時則會透過狀態燈提示。
近期 macOS Tahoe 測試版流出的示範影片，一度讓外界猜測這款產品可能提前登場。不過，綜合目前消息，配備鏡頭的 AirPods Pro 仍較可能等到 2027 年才推出。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) has confirmed it will hold its "Surprise and Shine" autumn event at 10 a.m. Pacific Time on September 9 (1 a.m. Taiwan time on September 10). The news lifted Apple shares more than 1% to $313.45 per share.

The market expects the launch of the iPhone 18 Pro series and Apple’s first foldable iPhone. This will also be the first product showcase led by John Ternus, who took over as CEO from Tim Cook on September 1.

The event is expected to follow recent formats, relying mainly on pre‑recorded videos and live streaming via YouTube, Apple’s website and the Apple TV app. Apple will also host a media‑experience session at Apple Park where attendees can try the new devices hands‑on.
There are many new products slated for the autumn, but they may not all appear in September. Apple could hold a second, or even a rare third, event later in the year.
iPhone 18 Pro series: 2‑nanometer chip, price likely to jump
Apple will roll out the iPhone 18 line in two phases this year. The September event will debut the high‑end iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max first, with the other models following later.

The iPhone 18 Pro series is not expected to undergo a full redesign; upgrades will focus on internal specs. The new phones may feature a 2‑nm A20 Pro chip with improved packaging for better performance, energy efficiency and thermal management, as well as Apple’s in‑house C2 modem.

Design-wise, the camera module may be slightly thicker and new colors such as deep cherry could be added. Some rumors suggest Apple might move the Face ID sensor beneath the display to further reduce the front notch.

Camera upgrades are likely to be concentrated on the iPhone 18 Pro Max, which is rumored to exclusively sport a variable‑aperture camera that can adjust light intake and depth of field for more natural bokeh, rather than relying solely on software simulation.
Price could be the biggest variable. After a June price hike and a memory‑supply crunch, the iPhone 18 Pro line may cost about $300 more than the comparable iPhone 17 Pro models.
First foldable iPhone: price around $2,500
The most talked‑about product at the event may not be the iPhone 18 Pro but Apple’s debut in the foldable‑phone market, the iPhone Fold, which could also be branded iPhone Ultra.

Rumors indicate the foldable iPhone will use a book‑style hinge, with a 7.8‑inch inner display and a 5.3‑inch outer display, offering near‑tablet real‑estate when opened and normal phone operation on the outer screen when folded. The inner screen may feature an asymmetric rounded‑corner design.

Spec-wise, the foldable iPhone is expected to house the A20 Pro chip and 12 GB of RAM, dual 48‑megapixel rear cameras, and a 18‑megapixel front camera on each display. The inner screen may use an under‑display camera, while the outer screen could retain a punch‑hole design.
However, the device may lack a telephoto lens, which could disappoint consumers accustomed to flagship‑level camera suites.

The foldable iPhone is projected to become Apple’s most expensive phone ever. Earlier market estimates placed the price between $2,000 and $2,500, but rising memory costs could push the final price even higher.

Even if Apple officially unveils the device in September, it may not be available worldwide immediately. The United States is likely to be the first market, with other regions seeing a slower, phased rollout.
Apple Watch: modest upgrades
Apple Watch typically launches alongside the new iPhone, but the 2026 update is expected to be relatively limited.

The Apple Watch Series 12 is not expected to undergo major aesthetic changes; it may add new health sensors to the fluoro‑rubber band and introduce a new band‑connection mechanism, with most upgrades focused on internal specifications.
Apple Watch Ultra 4 could also appear. While there were reports of a redesign and added sensors, concrete details are still lacking. A major redesign of the Apple Watch may still be some time away.
Smart home: Siri AI as the upgrade core
Apple may also refresh the Apple TV 4K and HomePod mini. Both products were slated for earlier releases but were delayed to this autumn due to setbacks in the new Siri development.

The two devices are expected to retain their current looks, swapping in newer processors to support Siri AI capabilities. The Apple TV 4K might also ship with an updated Siri Remote, though specifics are unclear.

Another possible new product is the Home Hub, a smart‑home hub featuring a 7‑inch screen and a FaceTime camera that can control home devices, display notifications, calendars and handle communications.

The Home Hub could come in two versions: one with a semi‑moon base that connects to the screen, and another that attaches magnetically to various stands. While it’s not yet certain whether these three smart‑home products will debut in September, Apple retail stores are reportedly preparing for them.
iPad mini 8: OLED screen upgrade
The tablet line is not the focus of the September event, but the eighth‑generation iPad mini still has a chance to appear.
Rumors suggest the new iPad mini will upgrade to an 8.4‑inch LTPS‑hybrid OLED display, though it won’t support ProMotion’s high refresh rate, and it may switch to an A20‑series chip.
AirPods Pro: camera version likely delayed until 2027

AirPods Pro could see an update by the end of 2026, but a standard spec refresh is more probable. The most anticipated rumor is a camera‑enabled version that can capture surrounding environment data for analysis by Visual Intelligence.

Users would be able to ask Siri about objects or nearby surroundings, and the system may also support gesture recognition. The rumored camera would have about a 1‑megapixel sensor capable of detecting people and capturing 3‑D images, with a status light indicating when it’s recording others.

A recent demo video of a macOS Tahoe beta sparked speculation that the product might launch early, but based on current information, a camera‑equipped AirPods Pro is still more likely to arrive in 2027.

items.title: 〈貴金屬盤後〉PCE通膨加深Fed升息預期 現貨金價跌破4600美元
items.title_en: Gold Prices Fall Below $4,600 as PCE Inflation Deepens Fed Rate‑Hike Expectations
paras: 金價周三(26日)續跌，美國通膨數據大致上符合預期，加深了聯準會(Fed)9月可能升息的可能性，投資人等待Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)本周將在傑克森洞全球央行年會發表的演說。

黃金現貨下跌1.3%，報每盎司4595.93美元，周二曾漲至5月14日以來最高。
12月交割的黃金期貨收低0.9%，報每盎司4653.30美元。


美元升值0.3%，使以美元計價的黃金對其他貨幣持有者而言更加昂貴。
Zaner Metals副總裁兼資深金屬策略師Peter Grant說：「在今天數據公布前，金價走勢只是一些獲利了結……核心消費支出(PCE)數據大致符合預期，因此目前金價是在昨日區間裡盤整。」
美國商務部經濟分析局(BEA)周三公布，Fed用來設定通膨目標的PCE價格指數在截至7月的12個月上漲3.7%，略高於經濟學家預估的3.6%。
根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch Tool，交易員目前認為Fed下月升息的機率為40%，高於數據公布前的36%。市場目前定價顯示，Fed維持利率不變的機率為60%。
黃金本深不孳息，在高利率環境下通常會失去吸引力。
Grant表示，「我認為黃金的升勢開始重新確立。因此，我確實看到金價今年有可能重新站上5000美元」，他接著補充，黃金到2027年第2季有望再創歷史新高。
地緣政治方面，一名伊朗高級消息人士周三表示，伊朗與阿曼仍在敲定有關荷姆茲海峽協議的細節。伊朗革命衛隊(IRGC)先前表示，兩國已就如何共享這條水道及其收益達成協議。

其他貴金屬交易


現貨白銀下跌1%，報每盎司67.93美元。
現貨白金下跌1.4%，報每盎司1831.67美元。
現貨鈀金下跌0.1%，報每盎司1324.63美元。
paras_en: Gold prices fell again on Wednesday (26th), as U.S. inflation data largely met expectations, deepening the likelihood of a Fed rate hike in September. Investors await Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s speech at the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Summit later this week.

Spot gold dropped 1.3% to $4,595.93 per ounce, having risen to a May 14 high on Tuesday. December‑delivery gold futures fell 0.9% to $4,653.30 per ounce. The dollar strengthened 0.3%, making dollar‑priced gold more expensive for holders of other currencies.

Peter Grant, vice‑president and senior metals strategist at Zaner Metals, said, “Before today’s data release, gold was simply taking some profits… The core PCE data largely matched expectations, so gold is currently consolidating within yesterday’s range.”
The U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis released on Wednesday that the Fed’s PCE price index rose 3.7% over the 12 months ending July, slightly above economists’ forecast of 3.6%.

According to the CME FedWatch Tool, traders now see a 40% chance of a Fed rate hike next month, up from 36% before the data. Market pricing implies a 60% probability that the Fed will keep rates unchanged.
Gold is a non‑yielding asset and typically loses appeal in a high‑interest‑rate environment.
Grant added, “I think gold’s rally is beginning to re‑establish itself. I do see a chance for gold to touch $5,000 again this year,” and noted that gold could reach a new all‑time high in Q2 2027.

On geopolitical fronts, a senior Iranian source said on Wednesday that Iran and Oman are still finalising details of a Hormuz Strait agreement. The IRGC previously stated that the two countries had reached an accord on how to share the waterway and its revenues.
Other precious metals: spot silver fell 1% to $67.93 per ounce; spot platinum fell 1.4% to $1,831.67 per ounce; spot palladium fell 0.1% to $1,324.63 per ounce.

items.title: 輝達釋出超狂長期展望 美股期貨全面走高
items.title_en: NVIDIA Releases Unprecedented Long‑Term Outlook, U.S. Equity Futures Rise Broadly
paras: AI 巨頭輝達 (NVDA-US) 財報與長期展望優於預期，帶動大型科技股買盤回流，美股主要指數期貨週三 (26日) 盤後全面走高，那斯達克 100 指數期貨漲幅居前。
輝達週三盤後公布截至 7 月的會計年度第二季財報，營收達創紀錄的 962 億美元，較去年同期增加逾一倍，也高於 FactSet 彙整的市場預期 923 億美元，超越預估的幅度創近兩年最大。淨利達597億美元、每股盈餘2.46美元。調整後每股盈餘為2.22美元，也優於市場預期的2.10美元。
核心資料中心業務營收達 890 億美元，同樣優於分析師預估的 863 億美元，顯示AI運算設備需求依然強勁。
不過，記憶體晶片價格攀升正壓縮輝達獲利空間。
公司預估，預估第三財季毛利率指引則落在 73.5% 至 74.5% 之間，遜於分析師預期的75%，預計第四財季毛利率將在 71% 至 72% 之間觸底。
輝達表示，財測未納入任何中國資料中心營收。
受到毛利率展望不如預期影響，輝達股價盤後起初一度走低，但隨後在財報電話會議中由黑翻紅。
輝達財務長 Colette Kress 於電話會議中預估，2028 會計年度營收將成長約 70%，遠高於市場原先預期的 45%，帶動股價一度上漲逾 4%。
執行長黃仁勳稍後進一步表示，如果不是受到供應限制，輝達明年營收還能再翻一倍。公司目前也正設法排除部分限制供應的瓶頸。
輝達近來更深入參與AI基礎建設融資。本月稍早，公司宣布與華爾街大型投資機構合作，為最高 5,000 億美元的資料中心融資提供擔保，協助客戶取得購買晶片所需資金，並支持OpenAI在俄亥俄州的大型資料中心計畫。
針對外界質疑這種做法可能形成「循環融資」，Kress 表示，OpenAI等前沿AI實驗室目前受限於運算資源不足，因此需要輝達提供財務支持。她預期，這些業者未來可能成為史上規模最大的科技公司，輝達投入資金所取得的股權報酬也將十分可觀。
黃仁勳還提到，科技業正在經歷一場影響所有電腦公司的平台轉移，目前崛起的AI企業可望成為史上最具影響力的科技公司之一。
受輝達財報激勵，那斯達克 100 指數期貨上漲 0.9%，標普 500 指數期貨上漲 0.5%；道瓊指數期貨上漲 207 點，漲幅約 0.4%。
財報公布前，投資人態度謹慎，輝達週三正常交易時段下跌逾 1%，也是最近 9 個交易日中第 8 天下跌。
Laffer Tengler Investments資深證券分析師Jamie Meyers 表示，從長期投資角度來看，輝達目前估值已低到難以忽視；只要市場願意將評價基準往後推進，股價長期應有不錯表現。
其他科技股財報同樣提振盤後氣氛。
Salesforce (CRM-US) 第二季營收超越華爾街預期，股價大漲 13%；Okta (OKTA-US) 不僅繳出優於預期的成績，還受惠代理式人工智慧需求快速成長，盤後飆升近 20%。
美股三大指數週三收盤變動不大。市場消化企業財報之餘，也等待聯準會週四在懷俄明州傑克森霍爾舉行的年度研討會登場。
企業財報方面，百思買 (BBY-US) 將於週四盤前公布業績，Workday (WDAY-US)、Affirm (AFRM-US) 及 Gap (GAP-US) 則預計在盤後揭曉財報。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US), the AI giant, reported earnings and a long‑term outlook that exceeded expectations, sparking a rebound in large‑cap tech stocks and pushing U.S. equity futures higher across the board on Wednesday (26th) after the market close, with Nasdaq 100 futures leading the gains.

On Wednesday after the market closed, NVIDIA announced its second‑quarter results for the fiscal year ending July, reporting record revenue of $96.2 billion—more than double the same period last year—and beating the market consensus of $92.3 billion compiled by FactSet. The earnings gap was the largest in nearly two years. Net income reached $59.7 billion and earnings per share were $2.46. Adjusted EPS of $2.22 also outperformed the market expectation of $2.10.
Core data‑center revenue hit $89.0 billion, again beating analysts’ forecast of $86.3 billion, underscoring the continued strength of demand for AI computing hardware.
However, rising memory‑chip prices are compressing NVIDIA’s profit margins.
The company forecasts a gross‑margin range of 73.5% to 74.5% for the third fiscal quarter, below analysts’ expectation of 75%, and expects the fourth‑quarter margin to bottom out between 71% and 72%.
NVIDIA clarified that its financial projections do not include any revenue from Chinese data‑center operations.
The margin outlook disappointed investors, causing NVIDIA’s stock to dip initially after the close, but it later recovered during the earnings call and turned positive.

Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress, during the call, projected that revenue for fiscal 2028 would grow about 70%, far above the market’s prior expectation of 45%, which lifted the stock by more than 4% at one point.
CEO Jensen Huang later added that, absent supply constraints, NVIDIA’s revenue could double again next year, and the company is actively working to eliminate some supply bottlenecks.

NVIDIA has also deepened its involvement in AI infrastructure financing. Earlier this month, the company announced a partnership with a major Wall Street investment firm to provide guarantees for up to $500 billion of data‑center financing, helping customers secure the capital needed to purchase chips and supporting OpenAI’s large data‑center project in Ohio.

Addressing concerns that this could create a “circular financing” loop, Kress explained that cutting‑edge AI labs such as OpenAI are currently limited by insufficient compute resources and therefore need NVIDIA’s financial support. She expects these firms to become the largest tech companies ever, and the equity upside from NVIDIA’s investment will be substantial.

Huang also noted that the tech industry is undergoing a platform shift affecting all computer companies, and that emerging AI firms could become some of the most influential tech companies in history.
Encouraged by NVIDIA’s earnings, Nasdaq 100 futures rose 0.9%, S&P 500 futures climbed 0.5%, and Dow Jones futures gained 207 points, about 0.4%.
Before the earnings release, investors were cautious; NVIDIA fell more than 1% during normal trading on Wednesday, marking the eighth consecutive day of decline in the past nine trading days.

Jamie Meyers, a senior equity analyst at Laffer Tengler Investments, said that from a long‑term investment perspective, NVIDIA’s valuation is now low enough to be hard to ignore, and that the stock should perform well over the long term if the market is willing to shift its valuation benchmark forward.
Other tech earnings also buoyed after‑hours sentiment.

Salesforce (CRM-US) beat Wall Street expectations for Q2 revenue, sending the stock up 13%; Okta (OKTA-US) not only posted better‑than‑expected results but also benefited from rapidly growing demand for agent‑based AI, surging nearly 20% after hours.
U.S. major indices ended Wednesday with little change. While digesting corporate earnings, the market also awaited the Federal Reserve’s annual meeting in Jackson Hole, Wyoming, on Thursday.

In corporate earnings, Best Buy (BBY-US) will report results before the market opens on Thursday, while Workday (WDAY-US), Affirma (AFRM-US) and Gap (GAP-US) are expected to announce earnings after the market closes.

items.title: 亞馬遜AWS將向輝達採購200萬顆GPU
items.title_en: Amazon AWS to Purchase 2 Million GPUs from Nvidia
paras: 《CNBC》報導，亞馬遜(Amazon)(AMZN-US)與輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)宣布，亞馬遜網路服務(Amazon Web Services, AWS)將採購200萬顆輝達GPU，並使用輝達名為Vera的新款CPU。
輝達周三(26日)在財報會議上表示，AWS部分Vera CPU將與公司即將推出的AI晶片Rubin「整合」，另有部分Vera CPU則將以獨立形式部署。
這項交易顯示，儘管投資人擔心超大規模雲端服務商(hyperscaler)的支出能力可能已經接近極限，但這些業者仍持續大手筆投入。
輝達財務長Colette Kress表示，「前五大超大規模雲端服務商」的資本支出預計將從2026年的8,000億美元，增加至明年的1.3兆美元。
輝達周三盤後公布2027會計年度第二季財報，數字亮眼，並給出超出預期的財測，激勵輝達股價盤後一度上漲5%。
paras_en: CNBC reports that Amazon (AMZN-US) and Nvidia (NVDA-US) announced that Amazon Web Services (AWS) will purchase 2 million Nvidia GPUs and use Nvidia’s new CPU called Vera.

On Wednesday (26th), Nvidia said at its earnings conference that some of AWS’s Vera CPUs will be integrated with the company’s upcoming AI chip Rubin, while other Vera CPUs will be deployed independently.
This deal shows that despite investors’ concerns that hyperscalers’ spending power may be nearing its limits, these operators continue to invest heavily.
Nvidia CFO Colette Kress said that capital expenditures for the “top five hyperscalers” are expected to rise from $800 billion in 2026 to $1.3 trillion next year.
After the market close on Wednesday, Nvidia released its Q2 2027 financial results, which were impressive and exceeded expectations, prompting the stock to rise 5% in after‑hours trading.

items.title: 〈財報〉輝達業績超預期 估2028財年營收增70% 盤後一度漲5%
items.title_en: Nvidia Beats Expectations, Forecasts 70% Revenue Growth for FY2028, Shares Surge 5% After Hours
paras: 人工智慧(AI)晶片龍頭輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)周三(26日)盤後公布2027會計年度第二季(截至07/26)財報，業績亮眼，並給出高於市場預期的營收預測。受公司財測帶動，盤後股價一度上漲5%。
輝達位居AI產業核心，並在AI熱潮推動下快速成長。該公司的晶片被用於打造及服務最先進AI模型，而輝達也增加透過擔保及其他安排提供財務支持，讓新的AI資料中心能夠取得融資並興建。
黃仁勳在財報新聞稿中強調AI產業格局發生的劇烈變化。他表示，AI「已經到達轉折點」，並指出，需要大型GPU叢集的公司數量已經大幅增加。
黃仁勳表示，「去年這個時候，只有一家實驗室在推動整個建設。如今，我們正處於新一代AI實驗室與新創公司的黃金時代，多個尖端實驗室正在同步擴大規模，開放模型生態系蓬勃發展，實體AI也開始上線——美國及全球各地都保持強勁動能。」
距離OpenAI推出ChatGPT已近4年，輝達依然呈現驚人的成長，最新一季營收較一年前的467億美元增加逾一倍。
財務長Colette Kress在與分析師的電話會議中表示，輝達預期2028會計年度營收將成長70%，而分析師原本預期為44%。Kress表示，客戶的預測「顯示我們明年的成長將翻倍」，但她也表示，公司財測已反映供應限制。

Q2 財報關鍵數據 v.s. LSEG預估


營收：962.2 億美元 v.s. 921.7 億美元
調整後EPS：2.22 美元 v.s. 2.10 美元


第二季淨利潤較去年同期的247.6億美元、每股1.87美元，增加逾一倍至539.5億美元，或每股2.22美元。
不過，在經歷歷史性的三年漲勢後，投資人今年對輝達股票的熱情有所降溫，截至周三收盤，股價今年僅上漲13%，略優於那斯達克指數。雖然公司業務持續強勁，但來自超微(Advanced Micro Devices, AMD)、Google(Google)等公司的競爭正在逼近。此外，全球記憶體短缺仍無緩解跡象，輝達也面臨持續攀升的記憶體成本。

財測超越市場預期

輝達表示，預計本季(第三季)營收將達1,080億美元，正負浮動2%。分析師原本預期為1,042億美元。
根據輝達，這項展望不包含來自中國的資料中心銷售。

資料中心營收

輝達公布資料中心營收達890億美元，超越StreetAccount預期的863.3億美元，年增117%。
目前輝達92%的營收來自資料中心部門，其中包括市場領先的AI晶片營收。
輝達第二季總營收較去年同期成長106%。
雖然輝達仍依賴少數幾家大型網路公司——即超大規模雲端服務商(hyperscalers)——貢獻相當大比例的營收，但其他業務正逐漸加速。
輝達的AI雲端、工業及企業(ACIE)客戶第二季貢獻403億美元營收，年增138%。超大規模雲端服務商營收則增加逾一倍，達487億美元。

毛利率維持75% 預計Q4觸底

輝達毛利率連續第二季維持在75%，對一家硬體公司而言是驚人的水準，但隨著記憶體與晶圓等零組件價格上漲，毛利率正面臨壓力。
輝達表示，第三季毛利率將降至74%。
輝達預計毛利率將持續下滑，並在2027會計年度第四季觸底，介於71%至72%之間，部分原因是記憶體價格上漲。
財務長Kress表示，「我們希望直接說明這點，而不是讓它一直成為一個懸而未決的問題。如今的記憶體供應短缺，很大程度上正是由AI基礎設施建設本身所推動。」

投資收益增加

輝達第二季淨利潤中包含78億美元的股權投資收益，上一季則為159億美元。
這家晶片製造商已對包括英特爾(Intel)與SpaceX在內的公司進行大筆投資。

中國銷售仍微乎其微

輝達去年底獲得美國政府批准，可以向中國銷售部分較舊晶片，但在中國的銷售進展緩慢，目前也不清楚中國政府在多大程度上批准這些晶片進口。
財務長Kress在書面評論中表示，這些晶片的出貨量占公司資料中心營收不到1%。

供應採購承諾大幅增加

輝達表示，第二季的供應採購承諾金額從上一季的1,190億美元增加逾一倍至2,790億美元，「主要與記憶體採購有關」。
公司表示，「我們持續在供應、基礎設施及合作夥伴生態系各個層面進行策略性承諾，以掌握未來龐大的成長機會。」

260億美元股票回購

輝達表示，第二季在股票回購與股利方面支出260億美元。公司5月曾告訴投資人，已額外授權800億美元的股票回購額度。公司同時計劃發放每股25美分的股利。
近年來，隨著營收與自由現金流持續擴大，輝達也逐步提高資本回饋的規模。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) announced its Q2 2027 (fiscal year ending 07/26) earnings after hours on Wednesday, revealing strong results and a revenue forecast that surpassed market expectations, prompting a 5% rise in the stock price.

Nvidia occupies a core position in the AI industry and has grown rapidly under the AI boom. Its chips are used to build and serve the most advanced AI models, and Nvidia has increased financial support through guarantees and other arrangements to help new AI data centers secure financing and construction.

CEO Jensen Huang emphasized the dramatic changes in the AI industry landscape in the earnings release. He stated that AI has "reached a turning point" and noted that the number of companies requiring large GPU clusters has risen sharply.

Huang added, "A year ago, only one laboratory was driving the entire build. Today, we are in the golden age of next‑generation AI labs and startups, with multiple cutting‑edge labs expanding in parallel, the model ecosystem flourishing, and physical AI going online—strong momentum continues in the U.S. and worldwide."
Nearly four years after OpenAI launched ChatGPT, Nvidia continues to show remarkable growth, with Q2 revenue more than doubling from last year’s $46.7 billion.

Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress told analysts on a conference call that Nvidia expects FY2028 revenue to grow 70%, versus analysts’ original 44% forecast. Kress said the customer outlook "shows our growth next year will double," while noting the company’s forecast already reflects supply constraints.

Q2 key figures versus LSEG estimates: Revenue: $96.22 billion vs. $92.17 billion; Adjusted EPS: $2.22 vs. $2.10. Q2 net income rose from $24.76 billion ($1.87 per share) to $53.95 billion ($2.22 per share).

After a historic three‑year rally, investor enthusiasm for Nvidia has cooled this year; as of Wednesday’s close, the stock had risen only 13% year‑to‑date, slightly ahead of the Nasdaq. Despite strong business, competition from AMD, Google, and others is tightening, and global memory shortages persist, driving rising memory costs for Nvidia.
The forecast exceeded market expectations. Nvidia expects Q3 revenue of $108.0 billion, +/-2% variance, versus analysts’ $104.2 billion forecast.
According to Nvidia, this outlook excludes data‑center sales from China.
Data‑center revenue: Nvidia reported $89.0 billion, beating StreetAccount’s $86.33 billion estimate, up 117% YoY.
Currently, 92% of Nvidia’s revenue comes from the data‑center segment, including its market‑leading AI chips.
Nvidia’s total Q2 revenue grew 106% YoY.
Although Nvidia still relies heavily on a few large hyperscalers for a significant portion of revenue, other businesses are accelerating.
Nvidia’s AI cloud, industrial, and enterprise (ACIE) customers contributed $40.3 billion in Q2, up 138% YoY, while hyperscaler revenue more than doubled to $48.7 billion.
Gross margin remained at 75% for the second consecutive quarter, an impressive level for a hardware company, but margin pressure is mounting as memory and wafer prices rise.
Nvidia said Q3 gross margin will fall to 74%.
Nvidia expects gross margin to continue sliding, hitting a low in FY2027 Q4 between 71% and 72%, partly due to rising memory prices.
Kress said, "We want to state this directly rather than leave it hanging. The current memory supply shortage is largely driven by AI infrastructure construction itself."
Investment income increased. Nvidia’s Q2 net profit included $7.8 billion in equity investment income, down from $15.9 billion in the prior quarter.
The chipmaker has made large investments in companies including Intel and SpaceX.

China sales remain negligible. Nvidia received U.S. government approval at the end of last year to sell some older chips to China, but sales progress there is slow and it is unclear how much the Chinese government has approved for import.
Kress noted in a written comment that shipments of these chips account for less than 1% of the company’s data‑center revenue.
Supply procurement commitments rose sharply. Nvidia said Q2 supply procurement commitments jumped from $119 billion last quarter to $279 billion, "primarily related to memory procurement."
The company said, "We continue to make strategic commitments across supply, infrastructure, and partner ecosystems to capture the massive growth opportunities ahead."

$26 billion in share repurchases. Nvidia said it spent $26 billion on share repurchases and dividends in Q2. In May, the company told investors it had authorized an additional $80 billion in repurchase authority and plans to pay a $0.25 per share dividend.
In recent years, as revenue and free cash flow have expanded, Nvidia has gradually increased the scale of capital returns.

items.title: 伊朗何時回到談判桌？川普：完全沒時間表
items.title_en: When Will Iran Return to the Negotiation Table? Trump: No Timeline at All
paras: 美國總統川普週三 (26 日) 表示，不急於恢復與伊朗的談判，也未替德黑蘭重返談判桌設定期限。隨著美伊戰事即將屆滿半年，華府正同步運用制裁與軍事手段向伊朗施壓。
川普接受《半島電視台》訪問時說：「我沒有時間表，完全沒有。我不著急。」他宣稱，美國目前占據優勢，伊朗正面臨嚴重通膨，經濟也持續惡化。
談及華府對伊朗採取的施壓方式，川普表示，經濟制裁與軍事打擊同樣有效。他也批評伊朗政府惡劣對待人民，並殺害許多抗議者。
川普最新表態顯示，他已不再強調迅速結束中東衝突。
美國自 2 月 28 日對伊朗開戰後，川普曾聲稱戰事可在 4 至 6 週內落幕，但本週五將屆滿開戰半年。
美伊雙方今年 6 月曾簽署為期 60 天的諒解備忘錄，討論範圍包括荷莫茲海峽航運、解除制裁及伊朗核計畫，但協議已於本月稍早到期。
在外交進程停滯之際，美國本週擴大對伊朗的經濟制裁，將 60 個與伊朗往來的個人、企業及船隻列為制裁對象，試圖進一步孤立德黑蘭。
伊朗外交部則批評，美方措施違反國際法，並構成「系統性霸凌」。
外媒報導，伊朗最高領袖穆傑塔巴已下令，禁止將伊朗接近武器級純度的濃縮鈾運往海外，顯示德黑蘭對美伊和平談判中的關鍵爭議採取更強硬立場，受此消息影響，油價上漲超過 1%。
制裁與戰爭已對伊朗經濟造成壓力，里亞爾在自由市場跌破 1 美元兌 200 萬里亞爾，寫下歷史新低，食品與藥品價格也大幅攀升。不過，分析人士認為，經濟壓力即使加重伊朗民眾負擔，也未必足以迫使德黑蘭改變政策或重返談判。
paras_en: President Trump said on Wednesday (26th) that he is not in a hurry to resume talks with Iran and has not set a deadline for Tehran to return to the negotiation table. With the US-Iran conflict approaching its half‑year mark, Washington is simultaneously using sanctions and military measures to pressure Iran.

In an interview with Al Jazeera, Trump stated, "I have no timetable, absolutely none. I'm not in a hurry." He claimed that the United States currently holds the advantage, Iran is facing severe inflation, and its economy continues to deteriorate.

When discussing the pressure tactics Washington is using against Iran, Trump said that economic sanctions and military strikes are equally effective. He also criticized the Iranian government for its harsh treatment of the people and for killing many protesters.
Trump's latest statement shows that he no longer emphasizes a quick end to the Middle East conflict.
Since the US declared war on Iran on February 28, Trump has claimed that the conflict could end within 4 to 6 weeks, but this Friday will mark the half‑year anniversary of the war.

In June, the US and Iran signed a 60‑day memorandum of understanding covering issues such as shipping through the Hormuz Strait, lifting sanctions, and Iran's nuclear program, but the agreement expired earlier this month.

With diplomatic progress stalled, the US expanded sanctions against Iran this week, listing 60 individuals, companies, and vessels involved in Iran-related activities as sanctioned, aiming to further isolate Tehran.
The Iranian Foreign Ministry criticized the US measures as violating international law and constituting "systemic bullying."

Foreign media reported that Iran's Supreme Leader, Ali Khamenei, has ordered that highly enriched uranium not be shipped abroad, showing Tehran's tougher stance on the key dispute in US‑Iran peace talks. This news pushed oil prices up more than 1%.

Sanctions and war have put pressure on Iran's economy, with the rial falling below 2 million per US dollar for the first time in free market history, and food and medicine prices rising sharply. However, analysts believe that even though economic pressure increases the burden on Iranian citizens, it may not be enough to force Tehran to change its policy or return to negotiations.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元上漲 經濟數據強化Fed維持利率不變可能性
paras: 美元周三(26日)上漲，美國7月通膨數據好壞參半，使外匯市場參與者持續關注聯準會(Fed)的利率路徑。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.3%，報99.16。
美國經濟數據成為當天市場焦點。根據美國經濟分析局(BEA)，廣泛被視為聯準會偏好的通膨指標——核心個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數——7月月增0.2%、年增3.3%，均符合市場預期。月增率較6月加快，而年增率則維持不變。3.3%的年增幅明顯高於聯準會2%的長期目標。
若以整體PCE來看，7月月增0.2%、年增3.7%，略高於市場預期。與核心PCE類似，月增率較6月加快，而年增率則持平。
另外，BEA公布的美國第二季實質國內生產毛額(GDP)第二次估值維持1.5%不變，符合市場共識預期。其他方面，美國人口普查局表示，7月製造業耐久財新訂單增加1.1%，優於預期的0.4%增幅。
綜合這些數據，經濟呈現韌性、通膨仍頑固，讓聯準會在評估更多即將公布的指標時，有更多空間維持利率不變。
CME FedWatch工具也反映出這點，市場預期聯準會9月維持利率不變的機率，從一天前約60%升至接近64%。
美元在上周下跌後反彈
PCE數據公布之際，美國債券市場也正處於波動之中。
油價居高不下引發通膨疑慮，加上市場擔心大型科技公司為支應AI基礎設施支出而發行大量債務，導致上周長天期美國政府公債遭到大幅拋售。
美國財政部曾出乎市場意料採取干預措施，試圖抑制殖利率上升，但在美國政府債務突破40兆美元的消息傳出後，這項措施的效果有限。
一般而言，公債殖利率上升會產生類似升息的效果，因這會推高消費者與企業的借貸成本，通常有利於美元走強。
但上周美國債務的消息引發市場對美國財政狀況的疑慮，在這種環境下，投資人傾向將資金從法定貨幣轉向黃金或加密貨幣等硬資產。
美元指數上周下跌近1%，而黃金與加密貨幣則上漲。
目前市場焦點轉向聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)周五在年度傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)會議上的演講，投資人將從中尋找更多利率政策線索。
加幣在關稅壓力下重挫
加拿大幣兌美元恢復跌勢，美元兌加幣上漲0.3%，至1.3877加幣。隨著美加貿易談判破裂，以及華盛頓與渥太華相互祭出報復性關稅，加幣持續受到打擊。
日元走弱，美元兌日元上漲0.1%，至159.34。
日元在7月底一次具標誌性意義的聯合干預後，兌美元的漲幅目前已回吐約一半，但仍成功維持在160以下，而160被視為東京當局關注的重要關卡。
《路透社》稍早進行的一項調查顯示，如今有明顯多數的經濟學家預期，日本銀行(BoJ)最早可能在9月升息。
歐元兌美元下跌0.2%，至1.1651美元，區域交易員消化歐洲央行(ECB)執委會成員Isabel Schnabel的鷹派警告。她表示，儘管能源價格大幅下降，進一步升息仍有必要。
澳幣兌美元小幅上漲0.1%，至0.7172美元。政府稍早公布的數據顯示，通膨情況好壞參半。澳洲7月消費者物價指數(CPI)月增0.6%，但以年增率來看，CPI上升3.5%，低於6月的3.8%。

The company also secured long‑term supply agreements for indium phosphide (InP) substrates from suppliers in the United States and Japan, ensuring mid‑ to long‑term operational growth.

Huaxia (1305‑TW) held a press conference at the Taiwan Stock Exchange on the afternoon of August 26. In Q2 2026, the ongoing Middle‑East conflict kept ethylene and crude oil prices rising. Huaxia’s low‑cost inventory production turned the quarter profitable, ending a seven‑quarter loss streak with a quarterly EPS of NT$0.23 and a cumulative H1 EPS of NT$0.02, also reversing the loss from the same period in 2025. Looking ahead, Huaxia said the Middle‑East situation remains unstable and oil‑price volatility is hard to predict; starting in Q3, the company will maintain profit growth through annual adjustments and production cuts.

items.title: BTC會議落幕 國科會：智慧生技國家隊正式啟航全球布局
items.title_en: BTC Conference Concludes, National Science Council Announces Launch of Smart Biotech National Team for Global Expansion
paras: 行政院2026生技產業策略諮議委員會議(BTC)於今(26)日圓滿閉幕，此次會議在政府13個部會代表與產學研醫各界專家的跨界研討下，凝聚台灣生醫與智慧農業的升級共識。BTC召集人、國科會主委吳誠文表示，會議讓台灣透過生技結合AI，促進科技創新，也宣告智慧生技國家隊正式啟航。
此次會議，透過建立國家隊支持產業永續發展，BTC委員就科技應用、法規制度與產業永續三大面向提出27項總體建議，做為推動生技產業韌性升級與全球布局的關鍵策略。
國科會強調，在科技應用面上，推動Bio-AI與跨域科技驅動的生醫創新，如類器官晶片與藥物研發；結合基因體及其他體學與健康資料，加速應用於風險預測及疾病早篩；以實際需求為導向，推廣並擴大現有AI工具至農業應用。
法規制度面上建立基礎設施及延攬人才，串聯健保、電子病歷、生物資料庫等資料，規劃去識別化應用指引並透過如「健康資料特區」、「創新科技沙盒」，在安全環境下促進資料之研究與產業應用；同時建立「真實世界證據平台」與「創新健康科技暫時給付制度」，加速新興醫療科技進入市場。
產業永續面上，將生醫大數據及AI驅動生醫創新之軟硬體研發納入《生技醫藥產業發展條例》獎勵補助範圍，以配合國家「AI新十大建設」政策落實；擴增國發基金重點項目投資額度，資助臨床前轉譯研究及臨床試驗、及補足後續成長階段資金缺口；並透過衛福部優先採購國產AI 醫療、醫材及數位健康產品形成國內示範市場，累積臨床實績，並跨部會協助我國產業進軍國際。
吳誠文在閉幕致詞時強調，感謝此次委員及各部會協力解決生醫產業關鍵問題，強調政府未來將串聯醫療、健康、運動與農業等大數據，結合AI、半導體及醫療的優勢，縮短生技醫藥研發、臨床試驗及量產時程，降低成本、提高良率，建構涵蓋預防、診斷、治療與健康促進的大健康產業。
吳誠文表示，科研成果不應停留於論文，而要與工程、產業及場域合作，轉化為產品與服務，而非圖利廠商；政府將持續完善產業發展環境，形成正向循環，帶動醫藥、健康、農業等產業發展，促進台灣國民健康，也讓全球人類健康。
吳誠文指出，此次會議所凝聚的共識與建議，將成為政府推動生技產業政策的重要方向，就是要讓前瞻技術跨出實驗室、深入人民的生活場域，全面實踐用智慧科技服務人民、發展大健康產業的承諾，未來將結合 13 個部會的力量，透過跨部會合作研擬具體做法，引導台灣走向更繁榮、更健康的未來。
paras_en: The 2026 Biotechnology Industry Strategy Advisory Committee (BTC) of the Executive Yuan concluded today (the 26th). The meeting brought together representatives from 13 government ministries and experts from industry, academia, research, and medicine, forging a consensus on upgrading Taiwan's biomedical and smart agriculture sectors. BTC convener and National Science Council chair Wu Cheng-wen said the conference enables Taiwan to combine biotech with AI to drive technological innovation and marks the official launch of the smart biotech national team.

During the meeting, the BTC proposed 27 overarching recommendations across three key areas—technology application, regulatory framework, and industry sustainability—to support the national team in fostering sustainable industry development and to serve as critical strategies for resilient biotech upgrades and global positioning.

The National Science Council emphasized that, on the technology front, it will promote Bio‑AI and cross‑disciplinary tech‑driven biomedical innovation such as organ‑on‑a‑chip platforms and drug development; integrate genomics and other omics data with health information to accelerate risk prediction and early disease screening; and, guided by real‑world needs, expand existing AI tools into agricultural applications.

Regarding regulations, the council will build infrastructure and attract talent, linking health insurance, electronic medical records, and biobank data, and will draft de‑identification guidelines while leveraging mechanisms like a “Health Data Special Zone” and an “Innovation Technology Sandbox” to enable safe research and industrial use of data. It will also establish a “Real‑World Evidence Platform” and a temporary reimbursement scheme for innovative health technologies to speed market entry of emerging medical solutions.

On industry sustainability, the council will incorporate AI‑driven biomedical big‑data research and hardware development into the scope of subsidies under the Biotechnology and Pharmaceutical Industry Development Act to align with the nation’s “Top Ten AI Infrastructure” policy; increase investment limits of the National Development Fund for pre‑clinical translational research, clinical trials, and to bridge funding gaps in later growth stages; and, through priority procurement by the Ministry of Health and Welfare of domestically produced AI medical devices and digital health products, create a domestic demonstration market, accumulate clinical evidence, and coordinate inter‑agency support for Taiwanese firms to expand internationally.

In his closing remarks, Wu Cheng-wen thanked the committee members and ministries for tackling key biomedical industry challenges, stressing that the government will integrate big data from healthcare, wellness, sports, and agriculture with AI, semiconductor, and medical strengths to shorten biotech R&D, clinical trial, and mass‑production timelines, cut costs, improve yields, and build a comprehensive “big health” industry covering prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and health promotion.

Wu emphasized that research outcomes should move beyond academic papers to collaborations with engineering, industry, and field partners, turning discoveries into products and services rather than merely benefiting manufacturers. The government will continue to enhance the industry environment, creating a virtuous cycle that drives growth in pharmaceuticals, health, and agriculture, improves the health of Taiwan’s citizens, and contributes to global human health.

He noted that the consensus and recommendations forged at the conference will guide government biotech policy, aiming to bring forward‑looking technologies out of the lab and into everyday life, fully realizing the commitment to serve the public with smart technology and develop the big‑health sector. Future efforts will harness the combined strength of 13 ministries through cross‑agency collaboration to chart a more prosperous and healthier future for Taiwan.
